FAIL_TO_PASS: optional-chaining-null-values: supports optional chaining for null values
side-effects-object-literal-mutation-misc: detects side-effects when setting and/or calling properties on object literals
modify-object-via-this-a: tracks object modification via "this"
conditional-expression: only retain branches with side-effects
supports-core-js: supports core-js
getters-on-this: handles calling getters on "this"
deoptimize-pushed-array-element: deoptimizes elements pushed into an array
class-without-new: instantiating a class without "new" is a side-effect
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
retain-unknown-prototype-access: treats unknown builtin prototype properties as unknown
minimal-this-mutation: mutates "this" only if necessary on function calls
array-expression: Tree-shake known array prototype functions
computed-member-expression-assignments: detect side-effects in assignments involving computed members
parameter-call-mutation: tracks mutations of function parameters when called
array-mutation: tracks array mutations
use-var-before-decl: exercise `var` variables before their declarations
side-effect-es5-classes: omits ES5 classes which are pure (e.g. they only assign to `this`)
returned-array-mutation: tracks array mutations
static-class-property-calls: handles effects when calling static class properties
side-effects-object-literal-calls: detects side-effects when mutating object literals
